section_summary.extract_value: This section reports an exploratory factor analysis of the 15-item CEMS conducted on a sample of N = 238. Parallel analysis retained two factors (Pressure to Eat Messages and Restrictive and Critical Messages) after retaining 10 items; the two factors had eigenvalues of 3.37 and 2.66 and accounted for 33.69% and 26.64% of the variance, respectively. The final CEMS (10 items) used in remaining analyses is presented in Appendix A.
section_summary.evidence_source: We conducted an exploratory factor analysis on the 15 CEMS items using principle axis factoring and varimax rotation. Two factors had eigenvalues greater than those estimated from the random data criterion and were thus interpreted.
